key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Automatic data refresh interval in seconds.

key.name: panel-display
key.description: Show the remaining or used percentage of the primary Codex limit in the fixed panel format.

key.name: codex-binary
key.description: Leave empty to locate the codex executable automatically.

key.name: compact-label
key.description: Retained for settings compatibility; the extension uses a fixed panel format.

key.name: theme-id
key.description: ID of a built-in or user theme. Invalid values safely fall back to Classic.

key.name: theme-animation
key.description: Animate large theme artwork while the menu is open when system animations are enabled.

key.name: language
key.description: Use the system language or explicitly select English, Russian, German, French, or Simplified Chinese.
